cards.name: Dancing Fairy
cards.officialText: As long as this card remains in face-up Defense Position on your side of the field, increase your Life Points by 1000 points during each of your Standby Phases.

cards.name: Darklord Marie
cards.officialText: Once per turn, during your Standby Phase: You gain 200 LP. This card must be in the Graveyard to activate and to resolve this effect.

adapter.timingGate: requires a current TagDuel StandbyFlow task in responding state, bound to the active team and exact turn

eligibility: controller team is the team whose Standby task is resolving
not negated by the current pending effect or continuous monster-effect negation
dancingFairy.physicalOwnerSeat: derived from stable UID and retained separately from controller team

darklordMarie.activationSnapshot: captureDarklordMarieActivationUids records exact physical UIDs in the active team's shared Graveyard before the task opens
darklordMarie.resolutionZone: the same physical UID must still be in the active team's shared Graveyard
darklordMarie.ownerRouting: physical owner seat determines owner team; a card in the wrong team's Graveyard is rejected
darklordMarie.oncePerTurn: turnNumber:physicalUid ledger; one used copy does not suppress other copies

adapter.idempotency: separate event keys for Dancing Fairy and Darklord Marie plus per-UID turn keys; retry produces no second gain
adapter.teamLifePoints: shared LP totals; no artificial 8000 cap; both card families are combined against one before-snapshot
adapter.mutation: read-only plan; caller must atomically commit shared LP and both ledgers
adapter.privacy: public summary contains no card IDs, UIDs, hands or private identities
adapter.validation: TagDuel shape, physical UID uniqueness, 3+3 shared zones, separate Field Zone, Extra Deck <= 5 and active physical-seat rotation are checked without admitting/certifying the unimplemented card identities

behavioralGroups: Dancing Fairy 1000 LP and shared-team routing
Darklord Marie activation and resolution Graveyard snapshots
multiple copies and independent per-UID once-per-turn keys
per-copy negation for Dancing Fairy and Darklord Marie
active StandbyFlow task, task identity, turn, team and phase guards
LP above 8000 and immutable input state

limits: The adapter does not schedule the StandbyFlow task or register the card triggers in the central resolver.
The activation UID snapshot must be captured by the future resolver at task opening and persisted to resolution.
Per-card negatedSourceUids must come from the trusted resolving-chain context; the adapter validates physical identity but cannot independently prove the negation event.
The caller must atomically commit the returned LP tuple and ledgers; this module deliberately does not mutate TagDuel state.
The cards remain outside the certified/playable catalog until a separate approved admission and resolver integration.
